<body>
<header>
<h1>OpenGL <span>4.6 core profile</span></h1>
<div id="stats"></div>
<select id="sort">
<option value="alpha">sort: alphabetical</option>
<option value="count-desc">sort: group count (desc)</option>
<option value="count-asc">sort: group count (asc)</option>
</select>
<input id="search" type="search" placeholder="filter by name">
</header>
<main id="tree"></main>
<script>
"use strict";

const data = {{json_data}};

const tree = document.getElementById("tree");
const search = document.getElementById("search");
const sort = document.getElementById("sort");
const stats = document.getElementById("stats");

function sort_key(item) {
    return item.children ? item.label : item.snake;
}

function sorted_children(items, mode) {
    const arr = Array.from(items);
    arr.sort(function(a, b) {
        if (mode === "count-desc") {
            const diff = (b.count || 1) - (a.count || 1);
            return diff !== 0 ? diff : sort_key(a).localeCompare(sort_key(b));
        }
        if (mode === "count-asc") {
            const diff = (a.count || 1) - (b.count || 1);
            return diff !== 0 ? diff : sort_key(a).localeCompare(sort_key(b));
        }
        return sort_key(a).localeCompare(sort_key(b));
    });
    return arr;
}

function code_span(text, css_class) {
    const span = document.createElement("span");
    span.className = css_class;
    span.textContent = text;
    return span;
}

function leaf_element(item) {
    const details = document.createElement("details");
    details.className = "leaf";
    details.dataset.name = (item.snake + " " + item.camel).toLowerCase();
    const summary = document.createElement("summary");
    summary.append(code_span(item.snake, "snake"), code_span(item.camel, "camel"));
    details.append(summary);
    const body = document.createElement("div");
    body.className = "leaf-body";
    if (item.refpurpose || item.description) {
        if (item.refpurpose) {
            const purpose = document.createElement("div");
            purpose.className = "purpose";
            purpose.textContent = item.refpurpose;
            body.append(purpose);
        }
        if (item.description) {
            const description = document.createElement("div");
            description.className = "desc";
            description.textContent = item.description;
            body.append(description);
        }
    } else {
        const missing = document.createElement("div");
        missing.className = "no-doc";
        missing.textContent = "no official refpage in the khronos set";
        body.append(missing);
    }
    details.append(body);
    return details;
}

function group_element(node) {
    const details = document.createElement("details");
    details.className = "grp";
    const summary = document.createElement("summary");
    const triangle = document.createElement("span");
    triangle.className = "tri";
    const name = document.createElement("span");
    name.className = "name";
    name.textContent = node.label;
    const count = document.createElement("span");
    count.className = "count";
    count.textContent = node.count;
    summary.append(triangle, name, count);
    details.append(summary);
    const wrapper = document.createElement("div");
    wrapper.className = "children";
    for (const child of sorted_children(node.children, sortMode)) {
        wrapper.append(child.children ? group_element(child) : leaf_element(child));
    }
    details.append(wrapper);
    return details;
}

function apply_search() {
    const query = search.value.trim().toLowerCase();
    const leaves = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("details.leaf"));
    let hits = 0;
    for (const leaf of leaves) {
        const hit = query === "" || leaf.dataset.name.includes(query);
        leaf.classList.toggle("hidden", !hit);
        if (hit) {
            hits += 1;
        }
    }
    const groups = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll("details.grp")).reverse();
    for (const group of groups) {
        const visible = group.querySelectorAll("details.leaf:not(.hidden)").length > 0;
        group.classList.toggle("hidden", !visible);
        if (query !== "") {
            group.open = visible;
        }
    }
    stats.textContent = query === ""
        ? data.total + " functions - " + data.missing_docs.length + " without official refpage"
        : hits + " of " + data.total + " functions";
}

let sortMode = sort.value;

function render() {
    tree.textContent = "";
    const root_element = group_element(data.root);
    root_element.open = true;
    tree.append(root_element);
    apply_search();
}

render();

search.addEventListener("input", apply_search);

sort.addEventListener("change", function() {
    sortMode = sort.value;
    render();
});
</script>
</body>
</html>
